spec.name: Blend v7
spec.notes: Multi-factor score: momentum, drift and low risk.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.2, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 8%.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 3.18 to 3.16 (change -0.02).
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 3.18 to 3.18. Strict mode changed no field or operator the signal uses.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is 3.10 (as submitted, 5 bps: 3.18); it breaks even at above 200 bps with daily turnover 0.02.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 3.18 against 3.18 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is 3.29 against 3.18 in research, a gap of -0.11.
The best year gives 19% of total P&L (year 6) and calm regimes give 149%; Sharpe is 7.09 in calm and -5.91 in stressed regimes.
The log holds 2 distinct specs; the best of 2 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.05, so the claimed 3.20 becomes 3.15 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 3.27 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.04, 95th percentile 0.50).
Perturbing the 4 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 3.18 to as low as 2.95 (as low as 3.06 at 25%).
The top 1% of days (21 days) give 15% of total P&L and the top 5 assets give 11% (net of the strategy's own costs).

series.label: cumulative share of P&L, best days first
